title: is this AI double standard true?
author: TheGamingSpringbok
selftext:
I've seen several AAA studios are using AI, like COD 7. Marvel Rivals even disclosed that they use AI in their financial reportings and in pretty much all processes, like code, art, textures, etcetera. 

Some games/companies using AI are Sony game studios, Square Enix, Epic Games (Fortnite) Tomb Raider, Ubisoft... you get the picture.

When i see indie dev's using AI, i noticed the reaction on platforms (like FB and Reddit) are vastly different. I was wondering if this double standard therefore is true? 

  
What do you guys think?
